post_series: Batting and pitching MVPs are called out above the box score and their rows are highlighted with MVP badges.

game_flow.ties: true extra innings; no synthetic tiebreak run
game_flow.walkoff: bottom 3rd or later ends immediately when home takes the lead
game_flow.pitching: every actual out consumes the current pitcher's series innings; skipped/walk-off halves consume no extra innings

pitcher_depth: Selected pitchers are ranked best-first and each receives the round's legal series cap, so the simulator moves to the next-best pitcher as caps are exhausted.
